resources.string: This app shows the Agent Workbench that runs on your computer, through an SSH tunnel on your home network. Nothing goes through the internet.

1. On your computer, in Agent Workbench, open “Remote access” and choose “Pair a phone”. Remote access and the computer’s SSH server have to be on.\n2. Paste the line it shows into your computer, where it says.\n3. Scan the code it shows.
That isn’t an Agent Workbench pairing code, or it comes from another version of the app.
Your computer doesn’t accept this phone’s key yet. Paste the line from the dialog into your computer: the phone keeps trying.
The code expired or was already used. On your computer, ask for a new one with “Pair a phone” and scan it again: the line you pasted still counts.
Point the camera at the code on your computer’s screen
No connection. Trying again in %1$d s.
Can’t find your computer on this network. Is the phone on the same Wi‑Fi, and the computer on?
Your computer is on the network, but its SSH server isn’t answering. It has to be on: the README explains how.
Your computer doesn’t accept this phone’s key. Pair it again from “Remote access”.
Your computer’s SSH fingerprint changed (now %1$s). If you didn’t reinstall its SSH server, don’t connect. To trust it, forget this computer and pair again.
Agent Workbench isn’t answering on your computer. Is it open, with remote access on?
Your computer didn’t accept this phone: remote access may be off, or the phone was revoked. If it was revoked, pair it again.
Another app on this phone is using port %1$d, which the tunnel needs.
This phone isn’t paired with a computer.
Shown while the phone keeps the connection open, as Android requires.
When an agent finishes or is waiting for you.
An agent is waiting for you
Notify when an agent finishes or is waiting for you
So notices aren’t delayed while the phone is idle, let the app run without battery restrictions.
The phone deletes its key and its credential for this computer. To use it again, you’ll have to pair it again. On the computer, also revoke it in “Remote access”.
